patch_description: Replace independent per-destination shortest paths with an exact directed-Steiner broadcast tree solver for typical broadcast sizes. The dynamic program jointly selects relay nodes and shared prefix links, so a transfer sent once from the source can fan out at low-cost intermediate clouds instead of paying for redundant source-to-destination routes. It uses reverse multi-source Dijkstra relaxation to account for the cheapest route from every possible relay to each terminal subset, reconstructs the selected shared arborescence, and writes each destination’s path through that common topology. For unusually large destination sets, it falls back to a multi-source greedy attachment strategy that still reuses already-reached nodes and links.
